name: Tecnam P2012 Traveller
summary: Modern nine-passenger Italian piston twin delivered since 2019, flown in the US mainly by Cape Air as the replacement for its Cessna 402s.

engines: Two piston engines on the wing with multi-blade (three- or four-blade) props
fuselage: Long, boxy cabin with a row of large round windows
Fixed tricycle gear with the main legs faired below the fuselage
tail: Tall swept fin with a low horizontal tail

tellTales: High-wing twin with a row of large round cabin windows
Fixed gear with the main legs faired at the bottom of the fuselage
Strut-free wing and a tall swept fin

confusedWith.howToTell: The Islander is boxier with rectangular windows and a straight-edged tail; the P2012 is smoother with round windows and a swept fin.
The 402 is a low-wing twin with retractable gear; the P2012 is a high-wing twin with fixed gear.
The P2006T is a small four-seat twin with retractable gear; the P2012 is much bigger with a row of round windows.

usCount.source: FAA Releasable Aircraft Database — valid registrations
